books.title: Energy Healing for Animals: A Hands-On Guide for Enhancing the Health, Longevity and Happiness of Your Pets
books.author: Joan Ranquet
books.description: A practical guide to using energy work with dogs, cats and horses, covering pet Reiki, massage, acupressure, chakras, Healing Touch and feng shui for the home. Joan draws on her years as an animal communicator to show owners how to support their animals' comfort, calm and wellbeing.

books.title: Emotional Freedom Technique for Animals and Their Humans: Creating Harmonious Relationships through Tapping
books.author: Joan Ranquet
books.description: An introduction to EFT tapping adapted for animals, with maps of the tapping points on dogs, cats and horses. It gives sample sequences for behaviour and emotional difficulties, for the bond between animal and owner, and for end-of-life care.
